markdown:
## Source and freshness

No live 2026 injury/practice feed exists yet. `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` still raises `ValueError: Season must be between 2009 and 2025` as of this run (06:15 UTC, 2026-09-07); Sleeper, ESPN and Rotowire remain proxy-blocked. This is expected, not a failure -- week 1's first game (SEA at NE) is Wednesday 2026-09-09, still two days out.

Fell back to the committed fixture `frontend/public/mock/league-2/weekly-report-week-1.json`, generated **2026-09-05T18:59:51Z**. Sanity-checked before trusting it: across the full 990-player pool, designations are genuinely mixed (812 Healthy, 93 Questionable, 71 IR, 14 Out) and `playProbability` spans 39 distinct values from 0.002 to 1.0, not one value per designation bucket. Also cross-checked the roster's 12 skill players against nflreadpy's live depth-chart feed (latest snapshot 2026-09-06T11:29:30Z, a day newer than the fixture) -- every depth rank matches what the fixture already assumed, so there is no role change the fixture is missing.

**Nothing has changed since the 2026-09-05 Saturday briefing.** Same fixture, same roster, same optimal lineup, same total (129.74).

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected pts | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Jaxson Dart | @DAL | 17.98 | 94.0% | 19.14 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs BAL | 17.02 | 90.5% | 18.80 |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | @DAL | 13.73 | 90.5% | 15.17 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs NE (Wed) | 18.07 | 93.6% | 19.30 |
| WR | Drake London | @PIT | 13.52 | 93.6% | 14.44 |
| TE | Brock Bowers | vs MIA | 13.63 | 89.6% | 15.21 |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving | @CIN | 12.29 | 90.5% | 13.58 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | vs NO | 9.29 | 78.7% | 11.81 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | vs ARI | 7.22 | 90.3% | 7.99 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs WAS | 6.99 | 100% | 6.99 |
| **Total** | | | **129.74** | | |

Bench (expected-points order): Harold Fannin Jr. TE (9.25), Quentin Johnston WR (8.38), Tee Higgins WR (8.12), Josh Downs WR (4.88), Matthew Stafford QB (15.95, no usable slot behind Dart).

One real decision on the roster: **start Jameson Williams over Tee Higgins at the second FLEX.** Higgins is Questionable at 52% to play; his if-he-plays number is huge (15.62) but expected value drops it to 8.12, below Williams' 9.29 at 79% to play -- and below Fannin's 9.25 too, though Fannin has no slot to fill since Bowers already starts at TE. Everyone else picks itself: Healthy players ranked by expected points, no position-minimum conflicts.

## Changes since the last briefing

None. Verified against `2026-09-05-sat`: identical fixture timestamp, identical roster (no waiver moves since the 9/3 Marks-for-Johnston swap already on record), identical lineup and total. The fresher depth-chart snapshot checked this run (2026-09-06) shows the same depth ranks the fixture already used for every rostered skill player -- no role movement to flag.

## Watch list

| Player | Why | News due |
|---|---|---|
| Tee Higgins | Questionable, 52% to play. The one lineup call hinges on this, and it's close (9.25-9.29 either way against Fannin/Williams). | First practice report ~Wed/Thu, final designation Fri 9/11 |
| Cameron Dicker | Questionable but 90% to play -- low real risk | Final designation Fri 9/11 |
| Josh Downs | Questionable, 52% to play -- bench WR, watch in case he becomes FLEX-viable | Final designation Fri 9/11 |

## Opponent notes

Jaxon Smith-Njigba's game (SEA vs NE) is the Wednesday 9/9 season opener -- it locks days before the rest of the roster's Sunday/Monday games. Set that WR slot early rather than waiting for the Friday designation wave that governs everyone else.

## Byes ahead

No rostered player has a bye in the next two weeks (weeks 1-3) -- clear through week 5. First cluster: **week 6** (Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams) and **week 7** (Cameron Dicker, the only K, and Quentin Johnston). No waiver claim is actionable yet for either -- zero games have been played, so there's no performance signal to rank a replacement against. Revisit once week 1 results land; with only 5 bench spots, the week-7 kicker bye in particular will need a streamer since there's no backup K rostered.

## Caveats

- No live 2026 injury/practice feed available; all figures come from the committed fixture's own availability-model output, not a fresh model call this session.
- Week 1 has not started (first kickoff Wed 9/9) -- this run's usual "the week just closed" Monday framing doesn't apply; treat this as a stable pre-season read, not a post-game recap.
- Nothing changed from Saturday's briefing. The waiver-wire suggestions in the underlying fixture (3 D/ST adds, all at an identical placeholder 6.99 pts because no games have been played) aren't useful guidance yet and are omitted from this report rather than repeated.
